title: Require bank selection before OTP and tie OTP step to entered bank details in Profile Setup

requirements.text: Update the Profile Setup flow so the user must select a bank (and enter bank account number) before they can request an OTP; requesting OTP should be disabled until these fields are provided, and error messaging should clearly ask the user to select their bank before requesting OTP.

quotes: bank account number does not take only take which bank your account and take bank side otp select bank

acceptanceCriteria: On ProfileSetupScreen, the “Send OTP” button is disabled until (a) a bank is selected and (b) bank account number is non-empty and (c) mobile number is non-empty.
If the user attempts to request OTP without selecting a bank (e.g., by any alternate UI path), the UI shows an English error toast/message that explicitly says to select a bank first.

requirements.text: Reset OTP state when bank selection or bank account number changes so that OTP verification always corresponds to the latest entered bank details and mobile number.

quotes: take bank side otp select bank

acceptanceCriteria: If the user has requested an OTP and then changes the selected bank, the UI clears OTP input state (requested/verified/code/demo code) and requires requesting a new OTP.
If the user has requested an OTP and then changes the bank account number, the UI clears OTP input state (requested/verified/code/demo code) and requires requesting a new OTP.
Existing behavior remains: changing the mobile number resets OTP state.

requirements.text: Adjust the OTP-step helper text on ProfileSetupScreen to reflect that the OTP is associated with the selected bank (while remaining a demo OTP), without introducing any real bank/SMS integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI text near the OTP request/entry indicates the OTP is tied to the selected bank (English), while still clearly indicating demo behavior (e.g., “In production, this would be sent via SMS”).
No new third-party/bank/SMS integrations are added; OTP continues to use the existing startOtpChallenge/verifyOtp calls.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Implement real bank-provided OTP delivery or integrate with any bank/SMS provider.
Add new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Change backend OTP APIs or persistence format unless strictly required by the frontend flow changes above.
